APPROVE

The extraction keeps the original checks in the same order with the same short-circuiting, so behaviour is unchanged, and it removes about six cognitive-complexity points, taking the method from 16 to roughly 9–10. Two things I could not check from the diff alone: that nullable annotations are enabled in this project (otherwise `string?` raises CS8632, an error under warnings-as-errors), and the rest of the loop body after the shown hunk, which still uses `key`.
